name: logs
summary: Show diagnostics from every subsystem, grouped by code (--all: one by one)
usage: ara logs [OPTIONS]

options.name: --root <ROOT>
options.doc: Project root (default: the nearest ancestor with ara.project.json)

options.name: --since <SINCE>
options.doc: Only entries new or repeated after this cursor

options.name: --author <AUTHOR>
options.doc: Who protocol commands are attributed to: human or agent:<name> (default: ARA_AUTHOR, else the agent running this CLI, else human)

options.name: --subject <SUBJECTS>
options.doc: Only entries about this subject (asset:@meshes/crate.glb, module:Gameplay, system:physics.step). Repeatable

options.name: --grep <GREP>
options.doc: Only entries whose message contains this text

options.name: --all
options.doc: List entries one by one instead of grouping them by code

options.name: --budget <BUDGET>
options.doc: Approximate size of the answer in characters (default 2000)
